newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 8.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Latest statistics show the Communist Party of China has 58 million members, 9.92 million more than five years ago.
- Ministry of Internal Trade and State Grain Reserve Bureau makes urgent call for local officials to buy summer grain at protective prices.
- Chinese leaders mark 60th anniversary of the July 7 Incident in the Memorial Hall of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression in Beijing.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference Li Ruihuan meets a delegation from the U.S. Committee of the One Hundred in Beijing
CHINA SECURITIES
- January-May interbank market trading hits 256.15 billion yuan.
- Shijiazhuang Refining and Chemical Co Ltd to issue 120 million A shares.
ECONOMIC DAILY
- Anhui and Shaanxi provinces complete purchases of summer grain quotas.
- Shanghai's 60,000 private firms absorb 102,000 laid-off state workers.
- Chongqing private sector absorbs 150,000 laid-off workers.
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- China Construction Bank loans 649 million yuan to Gebazhou hydro-electric power plant.
- Drug experts call for planting of passion flower to stop poverty-stricken areas from growing opium poppies.
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- Domestic sales of personal computers hit 1.1 million units in January-May, up 130 percent year-on-year.
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Agricultural Bank of China loans 500 million yuan to Sinopec's Ningxia Chemical Plant for expansion
- Vice-Governor of the People's Bank of China Shang Fulin says central bank to increase its macro-ecomoic forecasts.
CHINA DAILY
- The Ministry of Internal Trade expects to have at least three chain store businesses with sales volumes exceeding one billion yuan by the end of this year.
- At least eight people are killed and many others injured in floods over the weekend in Guangdong.
- About 2.84 million senior high school graduates, 180,000 more than last year, take examinations for more than one million places in 1.035 colleges and universities.
- China asks local officials to increase efforts to find employment for laid-off workers and guarantee their basic living standard this year.
- UN Development Programme to give China $1.89 million to fight HIV/AIDS.
